New advance payments of 26,00 € fall due on the 15th of each month starting 15.04.2025. Invoice date 17.01.2025. The recipient's street is the utility's own Kundencenter address but is listed as PII because it stands in the address block. The bill is shown reduced on an explanatory page, so its text is small. Page 2 (meter details) was not rendered.

type: estimated wastewater bill (Tulle agglo, annotated sample)
note: 'Montant à payer : 120,73 € TTC avant le 5 juillet 2021' (109,73 € collecte et traitement des eaux usées plus 11,00 € organismes publics); the stub repeats 'Montant à régler : 120,73 €'. Facture estimative du 14 Juin 2021. 'avant le' literally means before that day; 5 July is used as the deadline. Recipient, address and contract number (9999999) are placeholders. Page 2 (back of the bill) was not rendered.

type: electricity bill (EDF Guyane, annotated duplicate specimen)
note: 'total TTC 84,71 €'; 'Merci de votre règlement avant le 12/10/2018' (literally before that day; 12 October is used). Facture du 27/09/2018 for 11/08/2018 to 27/09/2018, based on estimated readings. The next reading (23/01/2019) and next bill (26/11/2018) dates are not deadlines. The breakdown number 0 594 31 31 31 is the fault line. The customer references under 'Vos références' are mostly zeros and too small to read reliably, so they are not listed as PII. The page is landscape: the bill fills the left half and the numbered explanations the right, so the bill text is small.

type: water, sewer and waste bill (Acueducto de Bogotá, demonstration bill)
note: Page 1 (cara 1): 'Pago oportuno 26/JUL/2024', 'Suspensión 31/JUL/2024', billing period 25/ABR/2024 - 22/JUN/2024. Page 2 (cara 2): 'Total a pagar $152.640' (acueducto $53.129 + alcantarillado $47.692 + otros cobros $-1 + aseo $51.820; Colombian pesos, the dot is a thousands separator). Service is suspended from 31/JUL/2024 if unpaid. The demonstration prints issue dates in September 2024, later than the payment date (as printed). Page 1 has numbered blue markers that hide parts of the header (not the dates); page 2 has 'Cara 2' / 'Cara 3' labels over the meter data and the lower tables. The property address is read as 'Cl 2 50 65'. The two pages come from two image files (see sources.json).

type: electricity, water and sewer bill (Fayetteville PWC, Spanish 'how to read your bill' insert)
note: 'Current Charges Due 11/12/09 $264.76', 'Total Amount Due $264.76'; date mailed 10/15/09, previous payment of $200.00 on 10/14/09. Payment must be received by 5:30 P.M. on the due date to avoid a 10% or $10 minimum late payment fee. The stub is marked 'Note: BANK DRAFT'. The explanations around the bill and the stub note are in Spanish, while the bill form itself is in English. The customer name is the placeholder 'PWC CUSTOMER'; the service address and account number are sample values. Numbered blue markers touch a few detail lines but none of the amounts or dates used.

type: water and sewerage charge notice, direct-debit version (Sapporo, sample)
note: 今回ご請求金額 4,224円 (水道料金 2,904円 + 下水道使用料 1,320円); '今回料金の振替予定日は令和　５年１０月３０日です' (the date is printed in full-width digits with a wide space after 令和). Issued 令和5年(2023年)10月2日. The right-hand part is a 口座振替済通知書 for the previous period (also 4,224円, debited 令和5年8月28日), which is a receipt and not a deadline. The address printed is the Waterworks Bureau's own; the phone is 'XXX-XXX-XXXX'. The name is printed with wide spacing (水道　太郎). The source PNG is 700 x 421 and was enlarged to 1800.

type: water and sewerage usage notice, direct-debit version (Chiba prefectural waterworks, sample)
note: 請求予定金額 14,656円 (水道料金 9,020円 + 下水道使用料 5,636円); '今回分振替予定日 7月16日'. The debit date is printed without a year; the meter reading date is 平成30年6月3日, so 2018-07-16 is used. The right-hand part is a receipt for the previous debit (振替済金額 7,556円 on 平成30年5月16日). The address is the sample '幕張1－▲－×' and the customer number is '00-0-000000' (not counted). The name is printed with wide spacing; the receipt part prints it as 'スイドウ タロウ０２'. '123-456-7890' is a placeholder for the meter-reading contractor; the customer centre is 0570-001245 (又は043-310-0321). Small numbered red markers sit beside the fields. type: automobile tax bill, first half of 2023 (Seoul Seocho-gu, redesigned bill illustration)
note: 납기 내 금액 214,420원, 납부기한 2023.6.30.까지. After the deadline the amount becomes 220,840원, payable until 2023.7.31. Taxation period 2023.1.1. ~ 2023.6.30., issued 2023년 6월 10일.
